facts.text: I want to create a content calendar to stay organized.
I have been quite active on Facebook groups lately.
I am starting a new project.
My project is focused on language learning and exchange.
I am passionate about language learning and exchange.
I want to create a mix of blog posts, social media posts, and videos.
I want to share language learning tips, resources, and cultural insights.
I want to feature interviews with language learners and native speakers.
I like having a mix of topics and formats to keep content fresh and engaging.
For language learner interviews, I want to highlight people from different backgrounds and languages.
For native speaker interviews, I want to focus on lesser-known languages and cultures.

I want to explore cultures like the Sami people.
I like the idea of a "Language Learner of the Month" feature.
I like the idea of a "Native Speaker of the Month" feature.
I want to use social media to share snippets or teasers from the interviews.
I will consider creating a podcast or video series focused on the interviews.
I am thinking about investing in basic recording equipment, including a good quality microphone and headphones.

I am thinking of conducting interviews via Zoom or Skype.

I have been quite active on Facebook groups lately.
I want to create a private Facebook group or community specifically for language learners and enthusiasts.
I want the private Facebook group to let people connect, ask questions, and share resources.
I want to host live events or webinars within the Facebook group.
I could invite language experts, native speakers, or other language learners to share experiences and insights.
I want to open up the floor for Q&A and discussion during the live events or webinars.
I want the live events or webinars to drive engagement and encourage more people to participate in the group.
